definitions.rho: sum(g*L_giver)/sum(g*L_receiver); pending penalty deducted; negative values retained; no GIVE undefined
definitions.solve_margin: call-start balance / round-start per-agent penalty, no pending penalty before SOLVE
definitions.top: round record picked_top; valid and invalid responses retained in solve denominator
definitions.allocation: initial + received GIVE + EXIT bonus = TALK + net SOLVE + charged penalties + outgoing GIVE + terminal balance; completion prize excluded
definitions.inference: descriptive outcome-conditioned comparison; 5000 paired-seed bootstrap draws over ten seeds; no independent agent bootstrap
definitions.early: rounds 1-2 TALK mean tokens per agent, divided by same-model 40-agent median
definitions.seat_reference: other models at same seed and initial allocation, all observed solves; fixed observed reference
